_meta.purpose: Maps every O*NET skill and knowledge element used by the catalogue to a plain-language description and a FREE learning route (FR-11, FR-12, PRD Section 13.3).
_meta.url_policy: Links point at stable portal or catalogue roots — never deep links into individual course pages, which rot silently and would leave a student staring at a 404. The student searches within a portal we can vouch for, rather than following a link we cannot keep verified.
_meta.commercial_policy: Next_Path has no commercial relationship with any listed provider and receives no commission. Paid alternatives are listed only where a genuinely distinct paid option exists; a null paid entry means the free route is sufficient, not that we failed to find a sponsor.
_meta.coverage: All 42 distinct elements appearing across the 27 catalogue careers. A skill with no mapping is not seeded, because a skill we cannot point at a free route for fails FR-12.

default_commercial_disclosure: Independent curated resource. No commercial commission or affiliation.

Reading Comprehension.description: Understanding written documents, manuals, and instructions accurately enough to act on them without misreading intent.
Reading Comprehension.free_resource_name: NCERT English textbooks and reading material (Classes 6-12)

Active Listening.description: Giving full attention to what people say, asking clarifying questions, and not interrupting before you have understood the point.

Writing.description: Communicating clearly in writing for the reader you are actually writing for, from emails to formal reports.
Writing.free_resource_name: NPTEL Technical and Business Writing courses

Speaking.description: Explaining ideas out loud so other people follow them — in meetings, presentations, and everyday conversation at work.
Speaking.free_resource_name: SWAYAM soft skills and public speaking courses

Mathematics.description: Using arithmetic, algebra, statistics, and quantitative reasoning to solve real problems rather than only exam questions.

Science.description: Applying scientific method and reasoning — forming a hypothesis, testing it, and revising when the evidence disagrees.
Science.free_resource_name: NCERT Science textbooks and SWAYAM science courses

Critical Thinking.description: Weighing options and evidence to judge which approach is actually better, instead of accepting the first plausible answer.
Critical Thinking.free_resource_name: NPTEL Critical Thinking and Reasoning courses

Active Learning.description: Working out what new information means for decisions you already make — the skill that keeps a career from going stale.

Psychology.description: Understanding how people think, feel, differ from each other, and respond to their circumstances.
